I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the deadline is **3 April**.

- **Where it came from:** Pree posted 25 August in #central-team on 14 Oct. Later that morning they corrected it in #central-random, saying the deadline is 3 April and they had read the wrong line. Hollis is in both channels, so I only used messages they can already see. A deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the team.
- **The year is open:** Pree didn't give one. The brain has 2027 saved, but that's an assumption from an earlier reply, not something Pree said. I told Hollis to check with Pree before putting a year on the account sheet.

The 25 August message is still in #central-team with nothing beside it pointing to the correction, apart from this new reply.
